Looking at the data, I need to compare the apparent magnitude values for globular clusters and irregular galaxies. Lower apparent magnitude means brighter objects, so "more apparent magnitude" means numerically larger values (dimmer objects).

```python
# Extract apparent magnitude values for globular clusters and irregular galaxies
globular_magnitudes = df[df['object type'] == 'globular cluster']['apparent magnitude'].astype(float)
irregular_magnitudes = df[df['object type'] == 'irregular galaxy']['apparent magnitude'].astype(float)

# Calculate the mean apparent magnitude for each type
mean_globular = globular_magnitudes.mean()
mean_irregular = irregular_magnitudes.mean()

# Compare: globular cluster has more apparent magnitude than irregular galaxy
answer = mean_globular > mean_irregular
answer
```
